quote_text:
Congratulations.
Thank you so much.
I know you've said for the last three  months that you've been very calm  
and you just look at performances, so  this must be a relief today, isn't it?
Of course, when you have this run without wins and  now you win in the cup and today in the league,  
in a short period of time, in one week's time,  it’s a big moment. I can see it on the faces of  
the players after the game. Our supporters have  been there in tough times and in good times,  
and today, the players put a smile on their  faces. The energy that the supporters give  
to the team when we are competing until the  end is so important. There were some parts  
of the game where Dundee were good on set  plays, creating situations inside the box,  
but the players kept running because of the  energy we created together with our supporters.  
That’s why it was so important, and it was good  to see them celebrate together after the game.
Personally, will you enjoy  this Saturday night now?
I'm going to enjoy it, yeah. We always have  to celebrate the small victories inside the  
season to gain new energy, and then tomorrow  we focus again on the next game. Of course,  
we have to be happy because I know how hard  everybody is working to get this win. We’ve  
also stayed stable during difficult times—we  didn’t panic, we didn’t get stressed—so it  
was nice to take the three points today. And of  course, we have to celebrate this victory today.
It was a special goal to win the game.
Yeah, it was a nice goal. And Tobi’s strike was  amazing. It was a fantastic goal, and it’s great  
when players take those shots and seize those  opportunities. So it was really nice to see.
What does it say about your team that  you lost a goal straight away but still  
managed to stay strong right to the end?  Is that one of the most pleasing things?
Yes, I think so. We talked about this after  the Hibs game, and the turning point for us  
was when everybody looked in the mirror and took  responsibility. That’s what we needed, and it was  
really good that everyone was accountable.  To be competitive during a season,  
inside the games, even if the opponent gains some  
momentum, you have to stay focused and be  strong. That’s what we did today. It was  
nice to see that we could stay in the game,  fight together, and get the three points.
You’re back up to third in the league now.
Yes, of course, it's really, really  good. That’s what I told you before,  
that’s what we’re aiming for, that’s the objective  for the season. But there are still many important  
games left, and we have to keep working hard.  It’s going to be an intense and competitive end  
to the season because there are so many teams  fighting for these positions. But of course,  
we are happy to take these three  points today and be up there again.
You must have been pleased with  the impact of the new players.
Yes, I think when the team is working well  collectively, it helps individuals play  
better. That’s how it works. Some players are  coming from preseason, some are between seasons,  
and others, like Pap, are coming back from  difficult injuries. But the team is starting  
to connect, play better together, and that  makes individuals look even stronger. So  
I’m happy with the collective effort, and  that’s what we need to keep building on.
What was the feeling for you  when the final whistle went?
It was nice. Of course, you have to be happy  when you know that everybody has been aware  
of the run we’ve been on. So of course, it was  great to finally get these three points today.  
It was quite exciting in the end, and there  were some moments that made it tense. But the  
spirit from the players was fantastic. Seeing  them celebrate together in the dressing room,  
and seeing them with the supporters before  we went inside, it was a really nice feeling.
Do you feel like this win takes a weight off  your shoulders and your day-to-day working  
life now that you've got that one out of the  way and people will stop talking about it?
I think for us, even when we weren’t winning,  
our focus was always on the next game. We never  allowed ourselves to get too distracted. Nothing  
is decided yet—the season isn’t over until May.  But at least now, we’ve won again, we’ve taken  
three points, and we can move forward. Now we  focus on the next game, which will be difficult,  
but we have to be ready. I think the team  is growing, and that’s a very good sign.
It’s important that this is  just the start, isn’t it?
Yes, exactly. We have to build on what  we did well today. After the cup game,  
I saw signs of how we play together, how  we defend and attack as a team, and how  
we handle difficult periods when the opponent  has momentum. That’s what we need to keep doing  
more of and carry into the next game. But we have  to prepare well, stay focused, and keep improving.
title: Jimmy Thelin FULL PRESS CONFERENCE | Dundee 1-2 Aberdeen
